label: VALIDATION (selection-biased) — not test results
scope: Scope: synthetic corruptions at 3 fixed severities on one dataset (EuroSAT RGB, one split). The numbers describe sensitivity to THESE corruptions only; they do not show general robustness, robustness to real sensor degradation, or robustness to distribution shift. No model is called robust.

confounds.resolution_upsampling: Corruptions are applied at 64 px. Pretrained models see an upsampled version (resize 256, centre crop 224) in which corruption and content are scaled together (a blur of 1 px becomes about 4 px); scratch models see both at native resolution. This is not a smoothing of the corruption relative to the content (robustness protocol, amendment 1); pretraining and resolution stay confounded, so group differences have no attributed cause.
confounds.pretrained_vs_scratch: ImageNet pretraining and input resolution are confounded with each other.
confounds.centre_crop: Pretrained models never see the 4 px border of a tile.
confounds.single_split: One fixed split: no split-to-split variance.
confounds.three_seeds: n = 3 seeds: the sd is itself uncertain; per-seed values are shown.
confounds.selection_bias: VAL chose each checkpoint; clean and corrupted VAL numbers share that bias.
